title.zh: 实际履行导出同律机会下界
title.en: Fulfillment implies a same-law chance floor

claim.zh: 有限配对情形中，逐情形覆盖有效需求且旧支持仍工作的目标，推出同一正总权重下的质量下界；对所有自然数权重保持质量等价于覆盖。
claim.en: In a finite coupled domain, pointwise coverage of demand with still-working old support yields a mass floor under one positive total weight; preservation for all natural weights characterizes inclusion.

hypotheses.zh: 有限情形列表、自然数事件权重、目标 demand AND oldWorks 及 Fulfilled；概率解释需正总权重。
hypotheses.en: Finite event enumeration, natural event weights, target demand AND oldWorks, and Fulfilled; probability interpretation requires positive total weight.

correspondence.zh: 配对、时段、覆盖与旧承担有效性需要证据；权重不是伦理重要性。
correspondence.en: Coupling, time window, coverage and validity of the undertaking need evidence; weights are not ethical importance.

detail.zh: J3 支持其承担解释；纯质量不等式没有这个规范前提。
detail.en: J3 supports the undertaking interpretation; the pure mass inequality does not itself require that normative premise.

detail.zh: 同一法则下同成功率不代表逐情形履行；事件修复的定义不保证及时有权限的实际实施。
detail.en: Equal success under one law need not fulfill the undertaking pointwise; an event-level repair definition does not ensure timely authorized implementation.

limitations.zh: 同一法则下同成功率不代表逐情形履行；事件修复的定义不保证及时有权限的实际实施。
limitations.en: Equal success under one law need not fulfill the undertaking pointwise; an event-level repair definition does not ensure timely authorized implementation.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 接管时复用此桥；新增任务仍须建立真实实施与有效承担。
next_delta.en: Reuse this bridge for takeover; additional tasks still require actual implementation and warranted undertakings.

history.zh: 2026-10-16，P114 散立的模块在共同基底上陈述（研究 §138；Ren 2026-10-15：“so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”）：主律在共同基底上陈述，不加前提：框架的主张在其列出的构型上由布尔事件读出：每个列出的、实现需求与旧支持的构型都实现新支持时，在每个权重下，被旧支持满足的需求质量在新支持的质量之内，后者在整体之内（claims_floor）；每个权重都使一个主张的质量在另一个之内，恰当凡实现前者的列出构型都实现后者（claims_every_weighting_iff）。Becoming.Courses 由核心运行编译与审计（回执 20261015T172257.067968Z），公理报告为空。论断、假设、Ren 的话、依赖与既有证明不变；只加引用、绑定、别名与本条。
history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: the claims of a frame read at its listed configurations by Boolean events: where every listed configuration realizing the demand and the old support realizes the new support, under every weighting the mass of demand met by old support is within the mass of the new support, and that within the whole (claims_floor); every weighting keeps one claim's mass within another's exactly where every listed configuration realizing the first realizes the second (claims_every_weighting_iff). Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
